================================================================================
async and await as field, tag and value identifiers
================================================================================

const UwTable = enum(u32) {
    none,
    sync,
    async,
    pub const default = UwTable.async;
};

const Io = struct {
    async: *const fn (userdata: ?*anyopaque) void,
    await: *const fn (userdata: ?*anyopaque) void,
};

const vtable = .{
    .async = async,
    .await = await,
};
